title: knowledge(web-services): under schema 2.0 an API enum field is a contract by member name, under 1.0 by caption
summary: A knowledge article clarifies how API enum fields are published: under schema 2.0 by member name with captions in entityDefinitions, under schema 1.0 by en-US caption as Edm.String. Good and bad code samples demonstrate the contract implications.
key_points: Schema version determines how enum fields are published in custom APIs, not the ordinal
Schema 2.0 (BC 24 default) uses strongly typed enums with member names in metadata and responses
Schema 1.0 (legacy) uses Edm.String with en-US captions in responses
Renaming enum members breaks schema 2.0 APIs even if captions remain unchanged
Virtual tables match by External Name, a separate mechanism from API schema contracts
